description: Hold, fracture, collapse, rebuild louder: give the listener four and a half minutes of stability in one minor key, warn them with a hole a minute before the break, drop the whole track a step into a new minor key inside the quietest valley, repeat one line six times in the wreckage, then rebuild past the original level and end at the track maximum — low and loud, sinking instead of fading.
name: digital_house_of_cards

sections.name: Near-silence intro
sections.notes: A void, not a fade-in: one window at -49.1 dB, peak -31.1 dB. Withhold the grid — first downbeat doesn't land until 11.19 s.

sections.name: Entry
sections.notes: Vocals from 7.6 s. Centroid climbs to 2600-3178 Hz by 0:35-0:55. Eb minor, third ambiguous at first (maj flips to min at 1:00).

sections.name: Main body I
sections.notes: The stable arch: mean -14.2 dB, centroid 2400-3100 Hz, Eb minor locked at 0.75-0.82 confidence. Hold it long — the stability is what makes the collapse read.

sections.name: Fracture
sections.notes: The warning hole: RMS -22.0 dB at 4:10 with centroid down ~1000 Hz to ~1400 Hz. The structure weakens before the level proves it. Spectral darkening first, level second.

sections.name: Collapse
sections.notes: 31 seconds, mean -20.5 dB, floor -24.5 dB at 5:05. Key drops a whole step to C# minor inside the valley. One line repeated six times ('I didn't get the breaks', 5:01-5:18) — the voice stutters where the structure breaks.

sections.name: Rebuild to loudest ending
sections.notes: 4+ minutes climbing past the pre-collapse level. C#/G# oscillation with major flashes. Track maximum in the final 30 s (RMS -8.7 dB, peak -1.4 dB) while the spectrum sinks into the low end (centroid 618 Hz at 9:15). Hard stop at 9:27 — heavy, not bright.

source_track: YOLO SNIPES - DIGITAL HOUSE OF CARDS (INTERNALISM track 02, 9:27.0)
